# octoquizpus.com

> Free interactive trivia quiz games on Bitcoin, board games, and more — available as Progressive Web Apps and on Android.

## Pages

- [Home](https://octoquizpus.com/): Hub listing all available trivia quiz topics with links to the PWAs and Google Play store.
- [Community Questions](https://octoquizpus.com/community-questions/): Browse trivia questions submitted by the community, paginated and filterable by category.
- [Submit a Question](https://octoquizpus.com/submit/): Submit your own trivia question to be reviewed and added to the community pool.
- [FAQ](https://octoquizpus.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions about octoquizpus.com — how to play, PWA installation, offline use, Android support, and how to submit questions.
- [Bitcoin Trivia Quiz PWA](https://bitcoin.octoquizpus.com): Interactive Bitcoin trivia quiz playable in the browser as a Progressive Web App.
- [Board Game Trivia Quiz PWA](https://boardgame.octoquizpus.com): Interactive board game trivia quiz playable in the browser as a Progressive Web App.

## Optional

- [Bitcoin Trivia Quiz Legacy](https://octoquizpus.com/legacy/bitcoin/): The original Bitcoin Trivia quiz (formerly bitcointrivia.org), preserved as a legacy page. Multilingual (DE/EN/FR), no longer actively maintained. Contact: hello@triviaquiz.games
- [Imprint / Impressum](https://legal.lueders.solutions/en/imprint/): Legal notice in German (Impressum, required under German law).
- [Privacy Policy / Datenschutzerklärung](https://legal.lueders.solutions/en/privacy/web-octoquizpus/): Privacy policy in German and English (GDPR / DSGVO). No cookies, no tracking. Hosted on Firebase Hosting (Google LLC).
- [Sitemap](https://octoquizpus.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://octoquizpus.com/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
